stages.notes: Story trophies are unmissable. Try Catch Me If You Can, Challenging Tank, Sneakthief and Capital Offense while their missions are live.
stages.summary: Play the campaign straight through and let the story trophies fall. Attempt the mission-linked missables as they come up rather than saving them for later.
stages.title: Story First Playthrough
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

stages.notes: Do the missables in the missable-first list order where you can; the choice trophies may need a fresh run.
stages.summary: Sweep up the choice-driven and cryptic trophies. Some need the opposite story decision, which means a second playthrough or mission replay.
stages.title: Choices and Second Chances

stages.notes: Nothing here is missable after the story except Fair Game, so hunt Bret's animal before moving on.
stages.summary: Work the stranger strands and the exploration collectibles while the map is still fresh. These are all available after the story.
stages.title: Open World and Strangers

stages.notes: Watch the stats menu counters; the money trophies pair well with the robbery grind.
stages.summary: The long counters: stunts, shooting range golds, vaults, races and money goals. Chip away at several at once instead of grinding one to the end.
stages.title: Grind and Mastery

stages.notes: If A Long Road has not popped, the tracker shows exactly which strand is still open — check the grade counts in the header to see which grades are missing.
stages.summary: Confirm the completion tracker reads 100%, then claim the platinum.
stages.title: 100% and Platinum
